discussion_comments.comment_body: Is a 2 minute `firstChunkMs` safe for hosted reasoning models? From what I can see in `streamText` (ai 7.0.120), the first chunk and chunk timers only reset on non-empty `text-delta`, `reasoning-delta` or `tool-input-delta` parts (plus `file`/`tool-call`). So a model that thinks for a while without streaming any reasoning text gets aborted as `before_first_chunk` even though the request is fine, and high effort runs can easily sit there past 2 minutes. Maybe only apply `firstChunkMs` when `timeoutMs` is set explicitly, or give it a much longer default than the header timeout?

discussion_comments.comment_body: Correct, and thanks for the precision. Registering the model only takes model *selection* off the catalog; `resolveBedrockModelId` still consults it, and with #14480 on main the bare `openai.gpt-6-astra` case goes out as `us.openai.gpt-6-astra` in us-east-1.
